newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline pushes higher in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline pushes higher in busy trade.

text.p: NWE gasoline pushed higher on Wednesday as gains in crude sentiment
Traders said Eurograde fob ARA barge swaps for April were done at $215.25 in late trade.
On the physical barge front, wintergrade material traded at $214 fob ARA, while summer specification barges traded at $213, $214 and $215 fob ARA.

Traders said the differential between between winter and summer grade material had been narrowed by persistant winter grade purchases by a trading house which has dominated the market over the past two weeks.

"We hope they're taking it out of the area, otherwise we've got 100,000 tonnes sitting in tank which will make it quite difficult for the market," one trader said. "I think they may be covering a few short positions out East."
On the cargo front, a number of players were looking into moving material to the United States.
"We're trying to work the arb but there's nothing doing just yet," said one trader.
Shipping brokers reported, however, that a European products trader had fixed a 60,000 tonne vessel out of Immingham going transatlantic loading March 31.
GE Warren were reported to have fixed a 33,000 tonne clean vessel for a European continental-U.S. Atlantic coast trip loading April 4.
